strike_region: forward relative at entry: below ATM means K/F < 1 and above ATM means K/F >= 1
side: original optimized option position side, not the sign of delta
delta: signed forward delta contribution including option side, optimized allocation fraction, and the universe-specific divider
universe_structure: ITM portfolios supply below-ATM calls and above-ATM puts; actual and normalised portfolios supply below-ATM puts and above-ATM calls
canonical_eight_category_view: attribution only: each strike-region/type bucket comes from the ITM or normalised optimization that contains that option; source universes remain explicit and are not summed into one portfolio
characteristic_attribution: separate source tables collapse synthetic put/call identity and attribute delta and P&L by long/short x below/above ATM, including long/short and strike-region marginal totals; no prediction
